name: onesignal
description: OneSignal onboarding & activation skills: install and initialize the SDK, provision your app and push credentials, and verify real delivery.

interface.longDescription: Install and initialize the OneSignal SDK, configure push credentials, and verify delivery. The bundled helper scripts need Python 3.7 or newer on PATH; the setup skill checks for it first and offers by-hand fallbacks when it is missing.
defaultPrompt: Set up OneSignal in this app.
Verify that OneSignal push delivery works.
